code='''def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    # Find rectangular outlines from matching full horizontal and vertical sides.
    for top in range(h):
        for left in range(w):
            if g[top][left]!=2: continue
            for right in range(left+2,w):
                if g[top][right]!=2 or any(g[top][c]!=2 for c in range(left,right+1)): continue
                for bottom in range(top+2,h):
                    if g[bottom][left]!=2 or g[bottom][right]!=2: continue
                    if all(g[bottom][c]==2 for c in range(left,right+1)) and all(g[r][left]==2 and g[r][right]==2 for r in range(top,bottom+1)):
                        for r in range(top+1,bottom):
                            for c in range(left+1,right):
                                if g[r][c]==0: g[r][c]=8
    return g
'''
